about: Where a name the reply marks to look up, [Name](check "City"), opens when no search result is its own site: a Google Maps search for the name and its city when it gives one, else a Google search for the name. The server places it when the reply is saved (apps/api/app/modules/chat/name_links.py, test_reply_links.py); the phone opens a marked name the same way while the reply streams (apps/mobile/lib/markdown/replyLinks.ts, lib/__tests__/replyLinks.test.ts; the drawn and tapped cases in components/markdown/__tests__/markdownRenderRules.test.tsx). Each address is encoded as encodeURIComponent encodes it. `markdown` holds whole marked links as the reply writes them: the server places each (`place_links`), and the phone, drawing it through MarkdownContent (whose typographer curls the apostrophe and whose parser escapes the city), opens the same address on a tap.
